reviews.title: Recent additional free plan restrictions ruined app
reviews.text:
This app used to be incredibly useful to me and helped me a lot in developing strong routines in the morning and evening.

However, as of late the app developers have decreased the cap of the number of tasks per routine for free users, and it’s completely ruined my routines. I can’t add anything more to my routine, and after I accidentally deleted a couple tasks while trying to move them around, I couldn’t add them back. 

Because the developers are not committed to keeping a stable set of activities you can always perform on the free plan, I recommend seeking out another app if you truly wish to develop strong long-term habits.

reviews.title: Not happy with latest updates
reviews.text: I’ve used this app for 5+ years and it’s been part of my daily life for years. It’s grown and grown and gotten better but the latest updates are SO confusing. It’s so much more visually cluttered than it used to be, and routines that used to be either “activated” or “archived” are now hidden based on when/where you want to start the routine. Took me ages to find a routine I had accidentally scheduled for yesterday. When I add new tasks to a new routine, I’m no longer suggested ones from other routines - a feature I used to love. I understand the new features and updates but as a long time user it’s becoming overwhelming and really ruining the simplicity of the app that I’ve relied on for years :( PLEASE BRING BACK SOME SIMPLICITY. Sincerely - someone who’s used this app since … 2019…?

reviews.title: New update ruined the whole app
reviews.text: I have been a dedicated, paying user of this app for over two years. I use it every night to schedule my next day, and it has been more effective than any anxiety medication I’ve tried in 10 years. I recommend it to every single friend and have shown it to several therapists and health professionals to try and get it more widespread. This app is maybe the most important part of my mental health and wellbeing. This most recent update destroyed it. Nothing is where it used to be, and it completely deleted a routine that I use every single day because I set it to “do not repeat” thinking that would move it to the “lightning” tab where my other unscheduled routine is. Instead, it got rid of a routine that I spent months perfecting, and then months relying on. Also, when you create a routine, they got rid of the feature that gives you the option to add the same tasks you’ve made before. For an app entirely based around routine, changing the entire UI without asking the user beforehand or offering the old version is a huge issue, and I may have to try to find/program a different system if I can’t overcome this problem, which is devastating.

reviews.title: They ruined it.
reviews.text: This app is garbage now. They changed the alarm so that it now only plays sound instead of making your phone vibrate. They also changed the alarm notification to look like an actual alarm, meaning you can just shut it off. The appeal of Routinery for me was that the alarm would push constant notifs to my phone and make it buzz with no way to turn it off except to start the routine. That always forced me to remember what I need to do. Without that, I know I'll just end up dismissing or missing entirely the notifs the app sends. It's useless now. Im canceling my subscription after being a loyal customer for years. Devs, please restore the old functionality and give us an option of vibrate-only alarms and push notifications that don't stop until you begin the routine!

reviews.title: Work in Progress Habits
reviews.text:
I’ve been using Routinery to help restructure my mornings, and as someone who is highly sensitive to overstimulation, I have found it to be a very helpful tool for managing my daily energy.
What I appreciate most is the sequential flow. Instead of feeling overwhelmed by a long list of tasks, the app guides me through one step at a time. It acts as a gentle pacer, which is essential when I’m trying to transition into my workday without feeling drained before I even arrive. It provides a sense of structure that helps me stay grounded when my routine starts to slip.
Overall, it is a great resource for anyone who needs to protect their morning routine and maintain a steady pace throughout the day.
I truly enjoyed using this to build a peaceful morning habit. It is perfect for someone who values slow mornings and wants to focus on healthy habits that provide peace of mind. I was even finding success with my evening routines. Unfortunately, because of the subscription constraints, I am unable to build an afternoon routine, which is a disappointing barrier.
While this is a great tool in theory, I am not pleased with the cost restrictions. I hope to return to the app in the future if there is a way to use it without a financial barrier, but for now, the subscription prevents me from fully integrating it into my life.

reviews.title: New update is cluttered.
reviews.text:
When running a routine, the bottom of the timer screen is now cluttered with the voice assistant, auto-next, context and white noise settings. I would appreciate if the visibility of these could be toggled in settings. 

I’ve also had issues regarding the alarm notification feature; when I open the app it will often only show the pulsating routinery icon and has to be force closed.

As a final niggle, apps such as TickTick allow users to edit what is visible in the tab bar. This feature would make the user experience far more enjoyable in the long run for those who are looking for a simple routine creator app, as opposed to a social app.

I do really appreciate the app, and am aware the problems are relatively small and fixable. But at the moment the app interface makes the subscription somewhat difficult to justify.

reviews.title: Gone downhill.
reviews.text: Recently I’ve had a really terrible experience with this app. It never works right for me. The voice settings randomly switch back and forth from beeps to voice, sometimes it will give me “five minutes until”, sometimes not…the whole point of this app is to make it effortless to help with my routines. I literally spent an entire “routine” trying to adjust my settings on my iPhone, accessibility, widgets, enabled notifications, making sure everything is updated, checking that I wasn’t on “focus” mode…. Nothing worked. The voice alarm settings are wildly inconsistent. Even if there is something I’m missing, I shouldn’t have to go on a whole wild goose chase through my phone. I held off writing this review because I wanted to make sure I was being fair and it wasn’t something I was doing on my end but…literally the voice settings change within the same routine, even if I delete the history and run it again, they will be wildly different the second time around. Awful. If you have ADHD and are looking for a helper app, this is not the one. It has sabotaged me multiple times this week. Which is sad, because it used to work great.

reviews.title: Useless app / steals your money
reviews.text:
DO NOT DOWNLOAD. DO NOT AGREE TO FREE TRIAL.

I downloaded the app after reading the reviews because I wanted something to help add structure to my mornings. I signed up for the 7-day free trial with the understanding that I’d either cancel before the trial ended or be charged after the 7 days.

Instead, when I opened the app, it asked me to log in if I already had an account. I entered my email and it said I did have one (I must’ve tried this app a long time ago). The second my login went through, it charged me the full YEAR fee immediately.

I did not agree to pay for a full year. I was not warned that logging into an old account would automatically trigger a full annual charge. I never received the free trial I signed up for — I was charged without my approval.

I contacted Apple for a refund literally within minutes of the charge (my bank alerted me almost instantly), and they still refused to refund it even after I explained exactly what happened.

The app is still as useless as it was the first time I tried it — except now I’m forced to pay for a full year of something I don’t want and won’t use, and no one will reimburse me.

This is NOT a case of me forgetting to cancel after the trial. I was charged immediately without consent because I logged into an old account. Misleading and shady.

Save your money. Use Apple Reminders or an app like TickTick instead. DO NOT download.

reviews.text: 갑자기 구독 기간이 없어지는 증상이 있고 구독권도 사라져 있네요 문의하는 곳은 어디인지도 모르겠고 그다지 좋은 어플은 아니라는 생각이 듭니다

reviews.title: アップデートの強制通知が最悪
reviews.text:
ルーティン中にアップデートしろ！という通知が画面中央にデカデカと現れて、バツボタンもないので、どうやっても消せなく、強制的にルーティンが中断される。

せめて、ルーティン中に邪魔をするのはやめてくれ、ルーティンが終わった後にアップデートさせてくれ。

こんなに、ユーザーの気持ちを考えない、使いにくいアプリ見たことがない。

reviews.title: バグが多い
reviews.text:
めちゃくちゃいいアプリだけど、バグが多すぎて使いにくい。
自動で次のルーティーンに進む設定にしても進まない、なぜか次ではなく2個先のルーティーンになることがおおい
